content_of_post_to_comment: Watched The Truman Show with my 3rd and 5th graders — any other suggestions for mind-bending but non-violent, non-scary films? Want to set up a thought provoking movie night. :)
comment: The best mind-bending films for kids might be the ones that make ordinary life feel strange afterward. The real test is whether they start questioning their own assumptions at breakfast the next morning.
